Legacy per-group thresholder (superseded by correlation_filtering())

Source: R/spectral_filtering.R
select_pseudo_spec.Rd

Not exported. Use correlation_filtering(cor_thresh, fdr_thresh).

Usage

select_pseudo_spec(correlations, cor_thresh = 0.5, fdr_thresh = 0.05)

Arguments

correlations

Per-group summary from a stats-contract closure (typically correlation_statistics()).

cor_thresh

Numeric. Minimum correlation to keep.

fdr_thresh

Numeric. Maximum FDR to keep.

Value

A data.table (possibly empty).
